home.heading: Welcome to BHW Connect
home.body: This is the foundation shell for Phase 1. Features roll out one increment at a time.

privacy.heading: Privacy Notice
privacy.body: The full Data Privacy Act notice ships with the consent flow in a later increment.
privacy.aiClause: Personal information and text typed by BHWs are never shared with external AI services. External AI processes only content that an administrator has authored or explicitly reviewed and cleared.

consent.heading: Privacy Notice & Consent
consent.intro: Before you continue, please review how BHW Connect handles your data.
consent.bodyWhat: We collect your name, contact details, barangay assignment, and your Chat Guide questions so the app can work for you and your barangay.
consent.bodyWhy: This data is used to run your account, support your barangay health work, and improve the Chat Guide's answers.
consent.bodyRetention: Chat messages and usage data are kept for up to 24 months; account and audit records are kept longer as required by law.
consent.bodyRights: You have the right to ask your admin for a copy of your data or to have your account deactivated and anonymized.
consent.genericError: Couldn't record your consent. Please try again.

ai.heading: External AI usage
ai.intro: Usage against the configured ceiling, set at 80% of each provider's published free limit. Personal information and BHW-typed text are never sent to an external AI service.

aiFlywheel.heading: AI-to-KB flywheel
aiFlywheel.intro: Every AI draft an admin publishes becomes a permanent KB entry, so the same question is answered without an AI call next time. If published entries keep rising while calls flatten, the loop is closing.

courseProgress.heading: Reset course progress
courseProgress.description: A BHW who opens a course before a session or pretest gate exists can get stuck: content progress exists, so the pretest is correctly refused, and there's no way to clear it short of resetting from here. superAdmin.heading: Super admin: test accounts
superAdmin.description: Linked test accounts let you use every role from this one login. Each one is a real account, so everything it does — completing a course, grading an assessment, submitting a flip chart — reaches the other roles exactly as it would for a real user. Switch into one, then use the bar at the top of the page to move to another or come back here. Reset a test account to start its progress over.
superAdmin.empty: No test accounts yet. Create one per role below.
superAdmin.resetWarning: This permanently clears this test account's course progress, pre/post tests, assessments, certificates, session enrollments, survey responses, notifications and onboarding, and hands back any assessments it had claimed. Content it authored stays.
superAdmin.resetNotice: Reset {username}: {courses} course(s), {tests} test attempt(s), {assessments} assessment(s), {certificates} certificate(s), {enrollments} enrollment(s), {surveys} survey response(s), {notifications} notification(s) cleared; {released} claimed assessment(s) returned to the queue.
superAdmin.createDescription: Pick the role and where it sits in the hierarchy. Put a BHW and the facilitator/assessor who should grade it in the same barangay — an assessor can only claim assessments from its own unit or below. An admin sees everything below its own unit. The username is generated from yours (e.g. rcventura.bhw).
superAdmin.createdNotice: Created {username}. Switch to it from the list above.
